job.purpose: Approved continuation of the natural-speed footage style.

input.prompt: Single continuous five-second candid live-action shot. Natural, practical human motion at full speed, normal 24 fps playback, no slow motion, no hovering or delayed reactions. Preserve the reference owner's exact identity, olive shirt, charcoal apron and all object positions except the described action. The owner puts his keys into a pocket, then walks purposefully out to the right along the clear sidewalk, leaving the frame. Two or three ordinary brisk steps, no lingering. His phone stays put away. The broken piano stays broken and still in the background; the worker remains by the truck. Fixed camera, footsteps and street ambience. No dialogue, music, captions, visible generated interface, logos or camera cuts.

result.expanded_prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
